versions.title: Streaming lakehouse on Databricks
versions.summary: Streaming tables that read each new file once, silver cleansed, checked and kept to the latest row per key, and gold materialised views, retried and alerted on failure, with roles granted and sensitive columns masked.

versions.title: Local medallion on DuckDB
versions.summary: Bronze tables loaded in full from CSV files, and a silver table cleansed, checked and kept to the latest row per key, all in one DuckDB file on a laptop.
